description:
A weak quadriceps gait pattern is demonstrated. This gait pattern, if left uncompensated, would result in knee buckling. This video includes an explanation of why these compensations exist. These include ground reaction forces and body weight forces that need to act in a way that make up for decreased knee extensor strength.
